[[File:Turkey.png|thumb|220px|An example of a pet ([[Turkey]]) in ''Adopt Me!''.]]
'''Pets''' are creatures in ''Adopt Me!'' that were released during the Pets Update on June 15, 2019. Pets will usually follow the player, can be looked after similarly to [[Baby|babies]], and can be aged up, allowing them to learn new tricks. Hatching [[eggs]] is the main way of obtaining pets, while players can also purchase specific pets using {{Robux}} or event currencies. Pets can also be made [[Neon Pets|Neon]] or [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon]] if four of the same pet are combined when they are all Full Grown or Luminous.

Players who join the game for the first time will receive a free [[Starter Egg]], which only hatches into a [[Cat]] or a [[Dog]].

== Types of Pets ==
=== Rarity ===
There are 5 main rarities in which pets, just like other items, are classified in: '''Common''', '''Uncommon''', '''Rare''', '''Ultra-Rare''', and '''Legendary'''.

Another less common pet rarity is '''Event'''; these pets were temporary pets that were removed from all inventories after a period of time. The two event pets as of now are [[Scoob]] and [[Pumpkin (Pet)]]. The [[2D Kitty]] was an event pet when it was first released on April 1, 2021, but it has since been rereleased as a legendary pet. Event pets age as fast as common pets, which are classified with common pets in the inventory.

=== Pet subcategories ===
There are many more categories pets can also be classed in, such as {{Robux}} Pets, event-exclusive pets, and limited [[Eggs|egg]] pets. These categories indicate the source or method of obtaining the pets. Players can only get a Safari Pet like a [[Flamingo]] from the [[Safari Egg]]s; this rule applies to every other limited [[Eggs|egg]].

== Neon Pets ==
{{Main|Neon Pets}}
As of July 13, 2019, it is possible to get [[Neon Pets|Neon pets]]. In order to do so, players must place four fully-grown pets of the same type into the slots in the [[Neon Cave]] located under the main bridge. They will combine to create one neon pet, a special variation of the pet in which some of its parts glow a special color. All pets can be made neon, except non-tradable pets like the [[Scoob]], [[Burtaur]], [[Pumpkin (Pet)]], and [[Pet Rock]].

To make a [[Neon Pets|Neon pet]] rideable or flyable, players will either only need one rideable/flyable pet for it, or they can alternatively feed it a [[Ride-A-Pet Potion]] or [[Fly-A-Pet Potion]] after turning them into a [[Neon Pets|Neon pet]].

== Mega Neon Pets ==
{{Main|Mega Neons}}
[[Mega Neons|Mega Neon Pets]] are pets in ''Adopt Me!'' that were released on April 17, 2020. To get a [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon pet]], a player must place four full grown [[Neon Pets|Neon pets]] of the same type into the slots in the [[Neon Cave]] located under the main bridge. These pets will then combine to create a [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon Pet]]. These pets usually glow through the colors of the rainbow, but there are some exceptions. All pets (except the [[Scoob]], [[Burtaur]], [[Pet Rock]], and [[Pumpkin (Pet)]]) can become a Mega Neon.

Players only need 1 out of 16 pets to be fly and ride to create a fly ride [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon]] pet. Players can also feed the pet a [[Ride-A-Pet Potion]] or a [[Fly-A-Pet Potion]] after the pet has been transformed.

== Friendship Levels ==
{{Main|Age-Up Potion}}
Friendship Levels were added to the game on July 13, 2023. Once a pet is full grown, it unlocks the ability to gain Friendship Levels, with one level being added to the pet for every 30 tasks worth of XP earned. For each Friendship Level gained, the owner of the pet receives one [[Age-Up Potion]], which can be used on any pet that is not full grown to age it up by 30 tasks. A pet's Friendship Bar will continue to fill up and display Friendship Levels without a limit, and reset to zero when that pet is traded; however, the levels will not return even when the pet is traded back to the original owner. When making a [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon]] or [[Neon Pets|Neon]] pet, the completed Friendship Levels of all the pets used will combine.

== Special Pet Items ==
=== Ride-A-Pet Potion ===
{{Main|Ride-A-Pet Potion}}
[[File:AM Ride-A-Pet Potion.png|thumb|100x100px|Ride-A-Pet Potion]]
Pets can be made permanently rideable if they are given a [[Ride-A-Pet Potion]]. This [[Ride-A-Pet Potion]] is available for {{Robux|150}}; it can be bought through the 'Shop' menu or inside the [[Sky Castle]]. Players must buy a [[Potions|potion]] for every single pet that they want to make permanently rideable.

If a [[parent]] is riding a pet, the pet will grow bigger to accommodate the [[parent]]'s size. If a [[baby]] is riding the pet, the pet will stay at its normal size.

=== Fly-A-Pet Potion ===
{{Main|Fly-A-Pet Potion}}
[[File:Fly-A-Pet Potion.png|thumb|100x100px|Fly-A-Pet Potion]]
Pets can be made permanently flyable (allowing the player to sit on the pet and fly it) if they are given a [[Fly-A-Pet Potion]]. This [[Potions|potion]] is available for {{Robux|295}}; it can be bought through the 'Shop' menu or inside the [[Sky Castle]]. Players must buy a [[Potions|potion]] for every single pet that they want to make permanently flyable; both [[Fly-A-Pet Potion|Fly-A-Pet]] and [[Ride-A-Pet Potion|Ride-A-Pet]] Potions can be used on the same pet to make the pet flyable and rideable.

If a pet is in flying mode, it will grow white wings with a pink trail, unless its original state had wings (such as the [[Robin]], [[Crow]], [[Shadow Dragon]], [[Parrot]], etc.), which it will use as its "flying" wings. The [[Arctic Reindeer]], [[Pet Rock]], [[Reindeer]], [[Ghost Bunny]] and [[Frost Fury (Pet)|Frost Fury]] pets do not need wings to fly and as such, don't gain any.

[[File:GoldenGoldfish.png|thumb|Golden Goldfish]]

Before July 14, 2022, players could obtain a [[Penguin]] or a [[Golden Penguin]] using the Golden Goldfish. Players had a 10% chance of taming a [[Golden Penguin]] and a 90% chance of taming a normal [[Penguin]]. From July 14, 2022 to November 7, 2025, players could obtain a [[King Penguin]], [[Golden King Penguin]], or [[Diamond King Penguin]]. There was a 2.5% chance of taming a [[Diamond King Penguin]], a 10% chance of taming a [[Golden King Penguin]], and an 87.5% chance of taming a [[King Penguin]].

It costs {{Robux|169}} and was available for 36 hours during the [[Desert Weather Map Update]], but the [[Desert Shop]] will return on the 15th of each month for 36 hours. Players have a 2.5% chance of taming a [[Giant Gold Scarab]], a 37.5% chance of obtaining a [[Giant Blue Scarab]], and a 60% chance of obtaining a regular [[Giant Black Scarab]] from a [[Mud Ball]]. According to its description, players must be in the [[Desert Shop]] to use it.

It costs {{Robux|169}} and was available for 36 hours during the [[Snow Weather Update]], but the [[Snowy Igloo Shop]] will return on the 28th of each month for 36 hours. Players have a 2.5% chance of taming a [[Diamond Albatross]], a 37.5% chance of obtaining a [[Golden Albatross]], and a 60% chance of obtaining a regular [[Albatross]] from a [[Golden Clam]]. According to its description, players must be in the [[Snowy Igloo Shop]] to use it.

[[File:Golden Leaf teaser.png|thumb|100x100px|Golden Leaf]]

[[File:Golden Bone.png|thumb|100x100px|Golden Bone]]

Players have a 77.5% chance of obtaining a [[Tan Chow-Chow]], a 10% chance of obtaining a [[Chocolate Chow-Chow]], a 10% chance of obtaining a [[Black Chow-Chow]], and a 2.5% chance of obtaining a [[Golden Chow-Chow]] from a [[Golden Bone]].

[[File:Golden Wheat in a player's inventory .png|thumb|100x100px|Golden Wheat]]
{{Main|Golden Wheat}}

Players have a 60% chance of obtaining a [[Brown-Chested Pheasant]], a 37.5% chance of obtaining a [[Green-Chested Pheasant]], and a 2.5% chance of obtaining a [[Black-Chested Pheasant]] from a [[Golden Wheat]].

[[File:Golden Corn.png|thumb|100x100px|Golden Corn]]

[[File:Goldenrod Flower.png|thumb|100x100px|Goldenrod Flower]]
{{Main|Goldenrod Flower}}

[[File:Snapdragon Flower.png|thumb|100x100px|Snapdragon Flower]]

[[File:Yarn Apple.png|thumb|100x100px|Yarn Apple]]

[[File:Super Fire Horse Apple.png|thumb|100px|Super Fire Horse Apple]]

The '''Frost Dragon''' is a limited legendary [[Pets|pet]] in ''Adopt Me!'' that was released on December 20, 2019. Players could purchase it in the event shop for {{Robux|1,000}}. As the event has ended, it can now only be obtained through [[Trade System|trading]].

== Appearance ==
The Frost Dragon resembles the [[Shadow Dragon]] in appearance. It has the same mesh but with slight differences: retextured icy blue scales, pastel-blue neon eyes, bright light-blue smoke particle effects coming out of its mouth, two horns shaped like those of a ram, and spikes protruding from its back. It has sharp teeth and a forked tongue.

Unlike the [[Shadow Dragon]], the Frost Dragon does not have an exposed ribcage. It has more spikes on its back than the [[Shadow Dragon]]. The wings are unchanged aside from the color. It also has a different head shape compared to the [[Shadow Dragon]].

== Tricks ==
Here are the tricks the Frost Dragon learns in order:
*Newborn - Sit
*Junior - Lay Down
*Pre-Teen - Jump
*Teen - Joy
*Post-Teen- Dive
*Full Grown - Frost Breath

== Neon Appearance ==
The [[Neon Pets|Neon]] Frost Dragon glows light blue on its wings, spikes, eyes, horns, feet, teeth, and tongue.

== Mega Neon Appearance ==
The [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon]] Frost Dragon glows in the same areas as the [[Neon Pets|Neon]] Frost Dragon, except those areas cycle through the colors of the rainbow.

== Trivia ==
*The original [[Mega Neons|Mega Neon]] Frost Dragon cycled through the colors blue and white. It was changed to where all of its glowing areas cycled through the colors of the rainbow, then later was changed again to where its eyes remained light blue. A final change was made to its eyes in a later update, which caused them to cycle through the rainbow again.
